svg.title: Ongoing / The inventory shell
svg.desc: What the browser is since Phase 4: one layout load of the whole catalog, a table filtered and sorted in the browser by the same pure functions the API runs, the URL carrying the query a CLI invocation would carry, and edits applied locally against the registry and the attention rules before the server answers. Every mutation here has an ongoing verb behind the same endpoint.. Architecture structure.
